card.title: STURMI
card.text: It costs the enemy +2 kredits to target or attack this unit.
card.flavorText: The Sturmgeschütz III (StuG III), nicknamed “Sturmi" by the Finns, was a German assault gun manufactured during WWII. The official Finnish designation for these vehicles was Stu-40, but they were widely referred to as "Sturmi". Finland purchased 30 StuGs from Germany in 1943 and another 29 were bought in 1944, and all were used during the Continuation War against the Soviet Union. The first 30 Sturmis were armed with the long barreled 75mm StuK 40 L/48 gun, which was an excellent anti-tank weapon capable of penetrating all but the heaviest Soviet armor. The Finns modified their Sturmis by adding extra armor and storage to improve survival and self-sufficiency during long front-line operations. These changes, along with their unique camouflage, made them look different from German StuGs. The Sturmi stayed in Finnish service for more than a decade following the 1944 truce with the Soviet Union.
